products.name: Breathe Free - Guava Biscotti - 3.5G Flower
products.description: Breathe Free presents Guava Biscotti, a premium 3.5g flower that delivers an exotic sensory experience. This carefully cultivated cannabis flower combines sweet tropical guava notes with rich, nutty biscotti undertones, creating a uniquely indulgent aroma and flavor profile. The dense, resinous buds showcase expert craftsmanship and attention to quality. Guava Biscotti offers a balanced experience that cannabis enthusiasts will appreciate for its distinctive terpene profile and smooth smoke. Whether you're exploring new strains or seeking something memorable, this pre-packed flower provides convenience without compromising quality. Each 3.5g package preserves freshness and potency, making it perfect for those who value both flavor and effect in their cannabis selection.
